overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Equity Income ETF (TEQI) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on large cap equity. TEQI is an actively-managed, non-transparent fund of global large-cap companies that are positioned to outperform the Russell 1000 Value Index TEQI was launched on Aug 4, 2020 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
